id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

job.description:
The job that was executed to produce this result. This will always be the job with `id`
equal to "ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserJob", since this type is a singleton.

status.description: Indicates whether the batch was successfully processed or not.

definitionVersion.description: The definition version that this batch should parse and persist.

assetClass.description: The {@link AssetClass} that was persisted as a result of this batch. If empty, an error occurred.

trackingId.description:
An identifier to give this result. Used to aggregate the result of the parser job
for a particular {@link Workflow.Run} of {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParser}.

error.description:
The error message that occurred during the processing of this batch. If empty, the batch was
processed successfully. This will most likely be an error caused by running
{@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionVersion#persistVersion}.

title: Represents the result of each batch of {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserJob}.
name: ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserJobBatchResult
